description.p: A simple, fast Markdown editor for GNOME with a live native preview (no web view), two-way click synchronization between editor and preview, smart list and table editing, and full TextBundle/TextPack support so documents can carry their images and attachments in a single file.

It also opens plain text, NFO art, JSON, YAML, TOML, shell scripts and XML with keyword highlighting, and offers itself under "Open With" for those file types. OpenDocument Text (.odt) files are imported as Markdown, and documents export to HTML, PDF and ODT.
The preview scrolls along with the editor, keeping the position bar in sight
The preview marks the part of the document the editor shows with a bar in its margin
Switching files from the Files panel or Open Recent returns to where you left each one: cursor, editor and preview scroll

ul.li: TextPacks in Windows-1252 or with CRLF lines open correctly
Packed links with spaces in angle brackets or escaped characters keep working
TextBundles with several text files open text.md first
ODT import keeps the spaces around links
ODT import keeps headings, code and quotes inside numbered lists
ODT export no longer writes characters LibreOffice rejects
Settings save again after opening a file whose name is not UTF-8
A full disk no longer risks truncating the file being saved
UTF-8 byte-order marks are dropped and UTF-16 files open correctly
Saving through a dangling symlink keeps the link
Network shares with a Windows domain or an IPv6 address reconnect

description.p: Memos support removed: Bindle no longer talks to a Memos server or the keyring, and needs about 140 fewer crates to build

ul.li: Opening a file from a slow share no longer discards what you typed while it loaded
Closing an unsaved document with Save keeps it in Open Recent
Picking a line by double-clicking beside it in the preview now works; clicking past a line's end moves the editor cursor
Copy Image refuses oversized images and decodes off the main thread; pastes stay in the document they were made in

description.p: Images inside TextPack and ODT files load off the main thread, so a pack on a dropped network share no longer freezes the window

ul.li: Preview: a second paragraph in a list item no longer runs into the first
Preview: oversized images are refused before decoding, remote downloads are capped, and local images load off the main thread
Preview: tables with wide characters stay aligned; HTML blocks get their own line
Highlighting: fewer false hits (apostrophes in YAML/TOML, shell words in paths and flags, underscores inside words, mismatched fences)

description.p: Files panel: pinned files always sit at the top of the list

ul.li: PDF and print: loose lists keep each item's text beside its bullet, and text after a nested list returns to its item's indent
ODT export: a web image inside a link (a badge) no longer becomes a link inside a link; local links with spaces are URL-encoded
ODT import: a heading ending in # keeps it
Ending a table with Enter or Backspace on an empty row clears the whole row
Line numbers include the empty last line of a file
Memos search no longer shows results for an earlier query
File names with brackets or parentheses insert as working links
Ctrl+click on a link to a missing file no longer stats it on the main thread
TextPack export keeps reference-style links working and leaves code blocks alone
Exports ask before including files from outside the document's folder; HTML export embeds only real images
Pack attachments open from your private runtime folder instead of the shared /tmp
Bundles made on Windows open with their line endings and accented letters intact
Exports and saved attachments are written atomically; a failed save no longer leaves pasted images behind
Copy Image no longer freezes the window on a slow network share

description.p: Preview: right-click an image → Copy Image, or select it and press Ctrl+C, copies the full-size image
Paste images into markdown documents: stored in assets/, or kept in memory until the first save
Preview: Ctrl+C copies a word selected there instead of going to the editor
Fit preview to width: an option that shrinks the preview to show the whole document's layout in a narrow panel
Files panel: right-click → Open Location shows the file in the file manager
Files panel: freeze a file so it stays in the list
Fix crash on start when the last document was open in view mode (GTK input-method race)
Fix crash on start when the last document was open in view mode
A recent file that was deleted or moved is dropped from the list when it fails to open (entries on a missing drive or share stay)
Files panel keeps its order while Bindle runs: clicking a file no longer moves it to the top (re-sorted by last opened at launch)
Files panel back on top, so its rows stay put when switching to a non-markdown file
Files panel sits between Insert and Preview, and lists names only (folder shown only to tell same-named files apart)

ul.li: Files panel: recent documents in the sidebar, one click to open (Panels → Show Files panel)
Warns when another program changes the open file, and asks before saving over it
Panel toggles and horizontal layout grouped under a Panels submenu

description.p: Preview tables wrap only while Word wrap is on
Tables in the preview re-fit when the window or panes are resized
Wide tables in the preview wrap their cells instead of scrolling sideways
Optional source line numbers in the preview (View → Line numbers in preview); double-click one to pick its line, Shift+click to extend
Double-click beside a line in the preview to pick it; Shift+click extends the pick

ul.li: Non-UTF-8 text files are read as Windows-1252 instead of being damaged on save
Saving no longer briefly exposes private files, and TextPacks keep symlinks and permissions
Line numbers, gutter Shift+click and the window subtitle fixes

description.p: Word wrap toggle in the View menu, remembered between restarts
Lines picked from the line numbers are highlighted in the preview too, whole table rows included
Extend a line-number selection with Shift+click instead of Ctrl+double-click
Double-click a line number to select that line; Ctrl+double-click extends the selection over several lines

ul.li: PDF export no longer drops the text around an image inside a link or emphasis
PDF export keeps images in table cells in their cell
Saving a memo under a new name stops offering Push to Memos for it
Ctrl+B, Ctrl+I and Ctrl+Space no longer edit the document while typing in the find bar or a dialog
Heading, list and quote snippets no longer prefix the line after a line-wise selection
Memo ids from the server can no longer steer a cache file outside the cache folder
A collapsed heading inside a quote keeps the quote styling on its marker
ODT import leaves a column unaligned when its cells are split evenly between center and right
Save As with another file type switches the layout and highlighting to match at once
Images in table cells show a placeholder in their cell instead of a thumbnail above the table
Keyword highlighting no longer keeps stale colours after deleting several lines
Inserting or attaching a file already in assets/ no longer empties it
Same-named attachments get a new name instead of replacing an existing asset
Edits made while a memo push runs are no longer marked as pushed
Saves and settings are written atomically, so a failed write can't truncate the file
An unreadable settings file keeps every setting that still parses and is backed up

description.p: The print toast no longer claims paper: the portal never says whether a job was spooled, filed or previewed.

ul.li: Print the rendered document: Ctrl+P, or Print… in the menu.
The PDF is laid out for the paper you pick in the print dialog, not scaled onto it.
Needs GTK 4.14, which Libadwaita 1.5 already required.

description.p: Checkbox clicks refresh the preview at once and never tick the wrong task right after an edit
Tick task list checkboxes by clicking them in the preview

ul.li: Ctrl+Space opens the Insert popup on any keyboard layout
The Insert panel heading shows its shortcut

description.p: Changelog in the About box
Fixed a crash when deleting the last lines of a document.
Imported ODT tables keep their column alignment.
OpenDocument Text support: .odt files open as Markdown (the original is never overwritten — saving creates a new file), and any document can be exported as ODT.
The homepage and source code links now point to oyzmo.no/apps.
Keys in YAML, JSON, TOML, shell and XML are highlighted in blue instead of green, so they no longer read as the same colour as the strings beside them.
